parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({complaint_id: $json.complaint_id, uploader_id: $json.uploader_id, filename: $json.filename, content_base64: $json.content_base64, sha256: $json.sha256, evidence_id: $json.evidence_id}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ok: true, evidence_id: $json.evidence_id, sha256: $json.sha256, mime: $json.mime, size: $json.size, filename: $json.filename}) }}

parameters.content: POST /webhook/evidence-uploaded. Validates type + magic bytes + size, computes SHA-256, assigns evidence ID, then registers metadata with the backend (which stores privately and writes the audit event). Requires NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto.
